purpose: V01d snow and sediment authored pixel scale
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL production material texture sheet for a restrained natural voxel game. Generate ONE perfectly SQUARE sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR equal square material swatches in a 2 by 2 grid, full-bleed with NO borders, gaps, gutters, labels, text or objects. Every quadrant is a flat orthographic ALBEDO material, evenly lit, fully opaque. All four designs use a COARSE 16 by 16 hard square-pixel grid per quadrant, broad connected 2-5 pixel patches, only 5 or 6 colors, no soft gradients, tiny noise, glossy lighting or perspective. Textures should tile quietly on all four edges; avoid a central emblem, repeating diagonal bands, brick mortar or framed outlines.
TOP LEFT: soft clean SNOW. Predominantly off-white approximately RGB 237,242,244 with two or three broad subtly stepped pale blue-grey depressions, all colors channels at least 185. Low contrast, large calm areas. No dark flecks, ice crystals, blue stripes, stone or dirt contamination.
TOP RIGHT: compact natural GRAVEL. Muted warm-neutral greys around RGB 135,132,123, with sparse larger angular pebble clusters 2-4 pixels across in slightly lighter or darker tones, touching in irregular quiet groups. Clearly granular compared to smooth massive rock but NOT a busy mosaic, tiny confetti, sharp black crevices, masonry or cobblestone pavement. Avoid tiny white highlights.
BOTTOM LEFT: dense smooth CLAY. Muted warm grey terracotta tan, around RGB 151,113,89. Broad irregular connected 3-6 pixel planes with two short discontinuous, nearly horizontal subdued clay seams, subtle mineral variations. Calm compact surface, low contrast, clearly warmer and lighter than mud. No cracks in a regular grid, no diagonal striping, stones, highlights or fine mottling.
BOTTOM RIGHT: damp SILT. Muted dark olive-brown earth around RGB 94,79,61. Broad joined 2-4 pixel moist soil clods with subtle ochre-brown patches and at most THREE subdued grey-brown embedded pebbles, each 1-2 pixels. Clearly darker than clay, with organic compact sediment character. No bright speckles, weeds, glossy wet reflections, regular pattern or diagonal lines.
The exact quadrant order is mandatory. Every pixel is opaque; no transparency or black alpha key. The shared broad pixel scale must feel appropriate on full cube faces, hand-held cubes and small inventory icons.
encoding: opaque RGBA; deterministic quadrant cropping and nearest-neighbour sampling only
